name: Anthropic
description: Trigger workflows when a message batch finishes or a model becomes available, and create messages, count tokens, list models and run message batches from a step.

triggers.label: A message batch finished
triggers.description: Fires once for each message batch whose processing has ended since the last poll, oldest first. Read the results with getBatchResults.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: An API key from console.anthropic.com/settings/keys, for a single workspace.
env.builderHint: Sent as x-api-key with anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 on every call. Keys have no scopes: a key without access answers 403 permission_error, a bad one 401 authentication_error. A multi-workspace key also needs anthropic-workspace-id, which is not sent, so use a single-workspace key. There is no CLI to borrow a login from.

triggers.label: A model became available
triggers.description: Fires once for each model released since the last poll, oldest first. The first poll looks 30 days back.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: An API key from console.anthropic.com/settings/keys, for a single workspace.
env.builderHint: Sent as x-api-key with anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 on every call. Keys have no scopes: a key without access answers 403 permission_error, a bad one 401 authentication_error. A multi-workspace key also needs anthropic-workspace-id, which is not sent, so use a single-workspace key. There is no CLI to borrow a login from.

actions.label: Create a message
actions.description: Send a conversation to a model and get its reply. Every call bills a generation.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model that will complete your prompt. Defaults to claude-sonnet-5.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as model. Ids the reference lists today: claude-fable-5-1, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5; listModels returns the live set and getModel resolves an alias.

inputs.label: Messages
inputs.description: Prompt text, sent as one user turn, or a JSON array of { "role", "content" } turns.
inputs.builderHint: Text becomes [{ role: "user", content: text }]; a value starting with [ is parsed as the messages array and passed through, so multi-turn and content blocks work. Consecutive turns of one role are merged by the API.

inputs.label: System prompt
inputs.description: Context and instructions for the model, kept apart from the conversation.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the top-level system string only when set; the API takes no system role inside messages.

inputs.label: Maximum tokens
inputs.description: The most tokens to generate before stopping; the model may stop sooner. Defaults to 1024.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as max_tokens. The connector does not stream, so keep it modest; a large job belongs in createMessageBatch.

inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: Randomness from 0.0 to 1.0. Leave unset for the default.
inputs.builderHint: Sent only when set. Models released after Claude Opus 4.6, the default model included, accept only 1.0 and reject other values with a 400.

inputs.label: Tools
inputs.description: A JSON array of tool definitions, each { "name", "description", "input_schema" }.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as tools; a single object is taken as one tool. input_schema is a JSON schema for the tool input; a tool call comes back as a tool_use block in raw.content with stopReason tool_use.

inputs.label: Stop sequences
inputs.description: A JSON array of strings that end generation when the model emits one.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as stop_sequences; one JSON string such as "END" is taken as a single sequence. A hit sets stopReason to stop_sequence and raw.stop_sequence names it.

outputs.description: Message id, msg_…
The model that answered
The text of the first text block; empty when the model answered with a tool call alone
end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence, tool_use, pause_turn, refusal or model_context_window_exceeded
{ input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens }
The whole response, with every content block and stop_details

actions.label: List models
actions.description: The models the key can use, newest release first.

outputs.description: One entry per model: id, display_name, created_at, max_input_tokens, max_tokens, capabilities
How many models came back

actions.label: Get a model
actions.description: Read one model by id, or resolve an alias to its model id.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A model id or alias, such as claude-sonnet-5.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of GET models/{modelId}; an unknown id answers 404 not_found_error.

outputs.description: The resolved model id
Human-readable name
Release time, RFC 3339; an epoch when unknown
Context window in tokens
Most output tokens per message
What the model supports, such as batch and thinking
The whole model as the API returned it

actions.label: Create a message batch
actions.description: Queue up to 100,000 message requests for asynchronous processing. Two calls queue two batches.

inputs.label: Requests
inputs.description: A JSON array of { "custom_id", "params" } where params is a full createMessage body: model, max_tokens, messages, ….
inputs.builderHint: Sent as requests; a single object is taken as a batch of one. custom_id matches ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ and must be unique within the batch; results come back keyed by it, not in order.

outputs.description: Batch id, msgbatch_…
in_progress, canceling or ended
{ processing, succeeded, errored, canceled, expired }
When the batch was created, RFC 3339
When processing ended; null until then
24 hours after creation, when unfinished requests expire
When cancellation was asked for, RFC 3339; null when it never was
Where the results stream from once processing has ended; null until then
The whole batch as the API returned it

inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment; an unknown id answers 404 not_found_error.

actions.label: Get batch results
actions.description: Read the results of an ended batch, one entry per request, matched by custom_id rather than by order.

inputs.label: Batch
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment; an unknown id answers 404 not_found_error.

outputs.description: One entry per request: { custom_id, result } where result.type is succeeded (with result.message), errored (with result.error), canceled or expired
How many results came back
